verses.text: Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, to those who received a faith as precious as ours through the righteousness of our God and Savior Jesus Christ:
May grace and peace be multiplied to you through knowing God and Jesus our Lord.
His divine power has given us everything we need for life and godliness through knowing the one who called us by his own glory and goodness.
Through these he has given us his precious and very great promises, so that through them you may share in the divine nature and escape the world’s corruption caused by evil desires.
For this very reason, make every effort to add goodness to your faith, knowledge to goodness,
self-control to knowledge, endurance to self-control, godliness to endurance,
mutual affection to godliness, and love to mutual affection.
If these qualities are yours and keep growing, they’ll keep you from being ineffective or unfruitful in knowing our Lord Jesus Christ.
Whoever lacks them is shortsighted and blind, forgetting that they’ve been cleansed from past sins.
So, brothers and sisters, make every effort to confirm that God has called and chosen you. If you do these things, you’ll never fall.
Then you’ll be richly welcomed into the eternal kingdom of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.
That’s why I’ll always remind you about these things, even though you know them and are firmly established in the truth you have.
I think it’s right to keep refreshing your memory as long as I’m alive in this tent of a body,
because I know I’ll soon put it aside, as our Lord Jesus Christ has made clear to me.
I’ll make every effort so that after my departure you’ll always be able to remember these things.
We didn’t follow cleverly made-up stories when we told you about the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ. We saw his majesty with our own eyes.
He received honor and glory from God the Father when the voice came to him from the Majestic Glory, saying, “This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased.”
We heard that voice come from heaven when we were with him on the holy mountain.
We also have the prophetic message made more certain, and you’ll do well to pay attention to it, like a lamp shining in a dark place, until day dawns and the morning star rises in your hearts.
First of all, understand this: no prophecy of Scripture comes from the prophet’s own interpretation.
Prophecy never came from human will. Instead, people spoke from God as they were carried along by the Holy Spirit.

There were false prophets among God’s people, just as there will be false teachers among you. They’ll secretly bring in destructive teachings, even denying the Master who bought them, and bring swift destruction on themselves.
Many will follow their shameless ways, and because of them the way of truth will be slandered.
In their greed they’ll exploit you with made-up stories. Their judgment has been ready for a long time, and their destruction hasn’t been sleeping.
God didn’t spare angels when they sinned. He sent them to Tartarus, putting them in chains of darkness to be held for judgment.
He didn’t spare the ancient world either, but protected Noah, a preacher of righteousness, along with seven others, when he brought the flood on the world of ungodly people.
He condemned the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah to destruction, reducing them to ashes as an example of what will happen to the ungodly.
But he rescued righteous Lot, who was distressed by the lawless conduct of those corrupt people.
That righteous man, living among them day after day, was tormented in his righteous soul by the lawless things he saw and heard.
So the Lord knows how to rescue godly people from trials and hold the unrighteous for punishment on judgment day,
especially those who chase after the corrupt desires of their sinful nature and despise authority. They’re bold and arrogant, and they aren’t afraid to insult glorious beings.
Yet angels, though stronger and more powerful, don’t bring insulting charges against those beings before the Lord.
But these people insult what they don’t understand. Like unreasoning animals, born to be caught and destroyed, they’ll be destroyed like animals,

suffering harm as the reward for the harm they’ve done. They think it’s fun to indulge in pleasure during the day. They’re stains and blemishes, delighting in their deceitful pleasures while they feast with you.
Their eyes are full of adultery and never stop sinning. They entice unstable people, and their hearts are trained in greed. They’re under a curse.
They’ve left the straight path and wandered off to follow the path of Balaam son of Beor, who loved the reward for doing wrong.
But he was rebuked for his wrongdoing: a donkey that couldn’t speak used a human voice and restrained the prophet’s madness.
These people are springs without water and mists blown by a storm. The deepest darkness has been reserved for them.
They speak empty, boastful words and use the desires of the flesh to entice people who are just escaping from those who live in error.
They promise freedom while they themselves are slaves of corruption, because people are slaves to whatever has mastered them.
If people have escaped the world’s corruption by knowing our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, but then get tangled up in it again and are conquered, they end up worse than before.
It would have been better for them not to know the way of righteousness than to know it and then turn away from the holy command handed down to them.
What happened to them fits the true proverb: “A dog returns to its vomit,” and, “A washed pig goes back to wallowing in the mud.”
Dear friends, this is now my second letter to you. In both I’ve tried to stir up your sincere thoughts by reminding you
to remember the words spoken earlier by the holy prophets and the command of our Lord and Savior given through your apostles.
First, you should know that in the last days mockers will come, following their own desires.
They’ll say, “Where is this promised coming? Ever since our ancestors died, everything has continued just as it has since creation began.”
They deliberately overlook that long ago the heavens existed and the earth was formed out of water and through water by God’s word.
By that same word, the world of that time was flooded and destroyed.
But by that same word the present heavens and earth are being kept for fire, held for the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly people.
Dear friends, don’t overlook this one thing: with the Lord, one day is like a thousand years, and a thousand years like one day.
The Lord isn’t slow about keeping his promise, as some people think. Instead, he’s patient with you, not wanting anyone to perish but wanting everyone to turn back.
But the day of the Lord will come like a thief. The heavens will disappear with a roar; the elements will be destroyed by fire, and the earth and everything done in it will be exposed.
Since everything will be destroyed this way, what kind of people should you be? Live holy and godly lives
as you look forward to and hasten the coming of the day of God. On that day, the heavens will be destroyed by fire, and the elements will melt in the heat.
But in keeping with his promise, we’re looking forward to new heavens and a new earth, where righteousness lives.
So, dear friends, since you’re looking forward to this, make every effort to be found by him spotless, blameless, and at peace.
Remember that our Lord’s patience means salvation, just as our dear brother Paul wrote to you with the wisdom God gave him.
He writes about these things in all his letters. Some parts are hard to understand, and ignorant and unstable people twist them, just as they do the other Scriptures, to their own destruction.
So, dear friends, since you know this ahead of time, be on your guard so you aren’t carried away by the error of lawless people and fall from your secure position.
Instead, grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be glory both now and forever. Amen.
